notes:
POC summary: 3-week hosted API trial (2026-01-20 -> 2026-02-10). Primary workload is the in-product conversational assistant for support + upsell (approx 70% of API calls), semantic search embeddings for product content (20%), and reranking for search results (10%).

Observed metrics (hosted trial):
- Sustained baseline QPS: ~8 QPS (business hours), typical concurrency ~12 sessions.
- Peak QPS observed during release-day spikes: single-minute peaks to 45 QPS; sustained peak windows (10-15 min) ~18-22 QPS.
- Average tokens per chat request (prompt + reply): ~420 tokens.  P50 latency for chat (hosted): 320ms; p95: 1.1s for longer contexts.
- Embeddings: batched job pushed ~6k documents/hour during nightly indexing; avg doc tokens ~110.
- Monthly extrapolated token volume from trial: ~180M generation tokens + ~10M embedding tokens (embedding units measured as 1 embedding request per document).
- Cost sensitivity: CFO wants unit-cost within +/-15% of current hosted spend, but with predictable reserved pricing.

Customer quotes/notes from calls: "If we can lock predictability and stay within a ~20% cost window, Dedicated makes sense". Nexus infra lead: "EU residency for a subset of customer PII is non-negotiable; need data residency and KMS integration."

Requirements called out: SSO/SAML integration, audit logs retention (1 year), option for customer-managed KMS, VPC private control plane, SLA for p95 latency and uptime. Routing requirement: route EU traffic to eu region dedicated pool; fallback to hosted in failover only.

POC learnings: hosted API handled functional correctness; performance variability during nightly batch indexing exposed need for predictable reserved capacity + burst policy. SE recommended moving embedding indexing to separate dedicated GPU pool to avoid affecting chat latency.

Next steps (short): finalize GPU sizing, confirm EU residency plan, legal review of MSA and DPA, CFO sign-off on ARR band.

capacity_recommendation: Conservative Dedicated design for steady-state + burst: reserve 2 x NVIDIA A10G-equivalent worker nodes for steady traffic (chat + small embedding lookups), 1 x H100-burst node for peak reranking and nightly embedding re-index. Separate small embedding-only pool (1 x A10G) for nightly batch to isolate latency. Target reserved concurrency headroom: 3x observed baseline -> plan for 30 QPS baseline capacity and 60 QPS burst. Expected p95 latencies: <400ms for short chat (<=200 tokens) and <1.5s for long chat (>=800 tokens) on dedicated configuration.
traffic_forecast_summary: Base-case (next 12mo): avg QPS 12 -> grows to 28 QPS at month 6 with feature launch; peak concurrency expected up to 120 concurrent sessions during campaigns. Token mix: generation tokens ~85% of total token volume, embeddings ~10%, reranking ~5%. Monthly tokens projection at close: 600M generation tokens, 35M embedding tokens. Estimated compute need: steady 2 GPUs (A10G) + 1 hot H100 for bursts; ops to enable autoscale with 15-minute scale-in buffer.
